title: Better Worldgen
description: This datapack is made for players who prefer a cleaner, less fragmented Vanilla world. It refines Minecraft's world generation while keeping the overall terrain largely unchanged and true to Vanilla Minecraft.
body:
# **Better Worldgen**
### **A Personal Take On Minecraft's Vanilla World Generation.**
> **Better Worldgen doesn't aim to add more content. Instead, it refines Minecraft's Vanilla world generation by removing terrain features that, in my opinion, disrupt the natural flow of the landscape.**
_________________________________________________________________________________________________
![Better Worldgen Cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e335e6f743f4ac3e9dda6c1101e5a8fb70949665.png)
_________________________________________________________________________________________________
**This datapack refines Minecraft’s world generation by removing and modifying various terrain features to create a cleaner and more consistent world generation. Mountains can now reach much greater heights due to the removal of the world generation height cap, while overhangs and small cliffs have been removed to produce smoother landscapes. Although caves still generate underground, large surface cave entrances, cave pillars, aquifers, and standard carvers have all been removed, resulting in a cleaner, less fragmented appearance in both the Overworld and the Nether. This also makes the underground feel smoother and more continuous, with caves becoming more enclosed and hidden. Additionally, underground sediments such as dirt, gravel, clay, and soul sand no longer generate, while surface and underground lava lakes, as well as natural water and lava springs, have been removed to prevent fluids from disrupting the terrain and cave systems. Structures such as mesa mineshafts are also disabled. Overall, the world becomes more uniform, structured, and calm while maintaining its underground cave network in a more natural and concealed form, all while staying true to Vanilla Minecraft.**
_________________________________________________________________________________________________
## **Changes:**

### **terrain:**
- **removed mountain height cap**
- **removed overhangs & small cliffs**
- **removed large cave entrances**
- **removed cave pillars**
- **removed aquifers**
- **removed carvers**

### **features:**
- **removed underground sediments (dirt, gravel, clay and soul sand)**
- **removed surface and underground lava lakes**
- **removed lava and water springs**

### **structures:**
- **removed mesa mineshafts**
